annotation.title_clean: Pro-worker AI: levers for harnessing the potential and mitigating the risks of AI in connection with employment and labour market policies
annotation.title_en: Pro-worker AI: levers for harnessing the potential and mitigating the risks of AI in connection with employment and labour market policies
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Economic and Social Committee own-initiative opinion on AI and work. It calls for an ad hoc EU legal instrument to strengthen social dialogue, enforce GDPR Article 88, extend Platform Work Directive algorithmic-management rules to all workers, and close AI Act gaps on FRIAs and worker consultation. A rejected counter-amendment is annexed.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for an ad hoc EU legal instrument on AI in the workplace to enforce enforced social dialogue
Extend Platform Work Directive Chapter III algorithmic management rules to all workers
Enforce GDPR Article 88 and clarify consent and legitimate interest in employment
Providers should carry out ex-ante Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments for high-risk AI; workers' representatives should be consulted, not only informed
AI Office should cooperate with social partners and issue guidelines on sandboxes and emotion-inferring systems
